title: More ways to work with your team and tools in ChatGPT
summary: New shared projects, smarter connectors, and compliance and security updates help teams get more done.
body: New shared projects, smarter connectors, and compliance and security updates help teams get more done.
summaryZh: OpenAI为ChatGPT推出了多项企业协作功能更新，包括共享项目、更智能的连接器以及安全合规更新，帮助团队提升工作效率并满足企业级安全需求。原始信息显示：New shared projects, smarter connectors, and compliance and security updates help teams get more done.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“More ways to work with your team and tools in ChatGPT”。其重要性主要体现在：展示了ChatGPT在企业团队协作与安全合规方面的产品演进，反映了大模型在企业级应用落地的趋势。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
